dedupe_keys.name: sahel crop vegetation and standardized precipitation index by municipality senegal and mauritania monthly since 2020 predisan

description: This dataset tracks crop and pasture conditions and rainfall anomalies for every municipality of Senegal and Mauritania. It was produced by the GIS4tech team of Acción contra el Hambre for the Food and Nutrition Security Monitoring and Prediction System in the Sahel (PREDISAN) project, funded by the Andalusian Agency for International Development Cooperation (AACID) and the University of Granada, and shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. Vegetation indices from MODIS (NDVI, EVI, ARVI and SIPI) and the Standardized Precipitation Index at 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months from CHIRPS rainfall are summarised as the median over each municipality and given by country, department, municipality, year and month. The CSV file, about 7 MB, runs from 2020 to August 2026 and is free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: municipal medians hide variation within large Mauritanian municipalities, and the indices describe vegetation and rainfall, not yields. Simulation uses: monthly drought and crop stress inputs for food supply shock and early warning models in the western Sahel. Related records: the Sahel livelihood zone profiles (data-sahel-hea-livelihood-zone-profiles) and Cadre Harmonisé data (data-cadre-harmonise-west-central-africa) give the food security context.
